title: Japan launches its offensive on Imphal
summary: The Japanese army crossed the Chindwin river to attack British and Indian forces at Imphal and Kohima in north-east India. Besieged but supplied by air, the defenders held, and the Japanese retreated with enormous losses.
reason: Japan hoped to stop an Allied offensive into Burma and perhaps spark an uprising in India.
significance: It was Japan's greatest land defeat to that point and opened the way for the reconquest of Burma.
